text:
Priya L: quick pass on Models grid (cards) in dark mode — keyboard navigation feels choppy. tab order lands on the first action button, not the card itself.
Tony M: yeah that's intentional right now, each card has a few small buttons (deploy, more) so we made them tabbable individually. but keyboard users probably want to open the card as a primary action.
Ivy (Design): my concern is discoverability. sighted users click the card, keyboard users should be able to open it with Enter/Space when focused on the card wrapper. current focus styles are inconsistent too (thin 1px outline).
Omar - Eng: implementation detail: cards are <div role="article"> with inner buttons. making the wrapper focusable (tabindex=0) is straightforward, but need to avoid duplicate tab stops on inner primary button. we could implement roving tabindex inside each card: only the wrapper tabbable, arrow keys to focus internal controls.
Priya L: that could work. another option: keep inner controls tabbable but set the wrapper to role="button" and add aria-label that includes call-to-action, then use CSS to ensure focus ring is high contrast.
Ivy (Design): for focus visuals in dark theme, the blue accent is too close to background on small borders. propose using a 3px glow with a 2px solid fallback. example: 
```css
.card:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06), 0 0 0 2px #6ad1ff;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
```
This gives a halo plus a bright ring.
Tony M: that should hit 3:1 on most sections. we should test with axe contrast rule for focus-rings.
A11yBot: automated scan: found 3 violations in cards grid: color-contrast (focus), duplicate tab stops (keyboard), and insufficient accessible name for card wrappers. Scanned 88 nodes.
Priya L: screen reader text: recommend `aria-label="Open model {name}. status {healthy|degraded}. Press Enter to open."` on the wrapper. For the inner deploy button keep `aria-label="Deploy {name}"`. Avoid repeating status in both unless needed.
Omar - Eng: question on truncated descriptions inside cards — VoiceOver truncates. Should we add `title` attr or `aria-describedby` referencing a visually-hidden element with full description?
Priya L: prefer `aria-describedby` for long descriptions so SR users can hear full details, but don't include it on every quick control — just the wrapper. Keep aria-label short and actionable.
Ivy (Design): layout nit: when the card gets focused, the shadow pushes neighboring cards visually (because of margins). can we apply an inset shadow or use outline-offset so layout doesn't shift?
Tony M: yes use outline/box-shadow with transform-style preserve. sample tweak: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(...)` and set `margin: -4px` visually but not in DOM. need to test overlap with rounded corners.
Omar - Eng: will prototype 2 approaches: (A) make wrapper focusable + aria-label + hide inner primary from tab order (tabindex=-1) but keep them reachable via arrow keys; (B) keep inner controls tabbable and add a focusable wrapper that responds to Enter only (risk: double focus). I'll evaluate which has simpler keyboard semantics.
Priya L: Accessibility considerations:
- Focus order should be logical: card wrapper -> control group -> next card.
- Use role="button" on wrapper if it triggers navigation; otherwise role="link".
- Avoid supplying overly long aria-labels (keep short actionable name).
- For badges (status/version) use aria-hidden=true and include short status in wrapper name.
Tony M: test plan: add Cypress keyboard e2e and a small Axe check in CI for the /console/models-grid page. I can add a test that tabs through first two cards and asserts activeElement is the wrapper.
Ivy (Design): i'll update Figma tokens for dark focus and add a note to the component spec about not shifting layout on focus.
A11yBot: note: save failing examples to /tests/fixtures/a11y-models-grid-failures.json
Omar - Eng: timeline: prototype today, PR tomorrow. If we can keep changes to CSS + aria attributes, small patch release is possible.
Priya L: follow-ups:
- Omar: prototype approach A & B + share demos (D: 1 day)
- Tony: add cypress + axe tests (D: 2 days)
- Ivy: update component doc + focus token (D: 1 day)
- Priya: final SR pass after PR merge.
Tony M: quick code snippet for test: 
```js
it('cards are keyboard accessible', () => {
  cy.visit('/console/models');
  cy.get('body').tab(); // first tabbable
  cy.focused().should('have.attr', 'role').and('match', /button|link/);
});
```
Priya L: thanks all. feel free to ping if any edge cases pop up (nested menus inside cards). :sparkles:
